channel.title: World News Live
channel.description: Daily news briefs: geopolitics, tech, sports, entertainment, business and world news, in our own words.

item.title: US Envoys Meet Putin in Moscow After Abu Dhabi Talks Agree Prisoner Swap
item.description: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Moscow for talks with Vladimir Putin, a day after two days of US-mediated negotiations in Abu Dhabi produced agreement on a prisoner exchange but no breakthrough on a ceasefire or territory.

item.title: Iran Warns US Bases Beyond the Gulf Could Be Targeted as Tankers Burn in Hormuz
item.description: Iran's top security official warned that American bases stretching from the Middle East to Europe could be hit if US strikes resume, as two tankers caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz and Saudi Arabia reported fresh interceptions.

item.title: Strike on Gaza's Nasser Hospital Kills Six, Health Officials Say
item.description: An Israeli strike on the Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis killed six people, including a medical professional, and wounded at least a dozen more, according to Gaza's Health Ministry and civil defence officials.

item.title: DeepMind's AlphaGenome 2 Predicts How DNA Behaves in Individual Cell Types
item.description: Google DeepMind's new model moves DNA-sequence prediction from broad tissue averages to the behaviour of specific cell types and cell states, trained on more than 107 million profiles.

item.title: Runway Opens Its Robot Brain to Everyone, Alibaba Previews Qwen4-Max
item.description: Runway released the weights and training code for Praxis-1, its 27-billion-parameter robot action model, while Alibaba Cloud opened a time-limited preview of its new flagship multimodal model Qwen4-Max.

item.title: Anthropic's IPO Book Swamped as TSMC Backs Both AI Labs
item.description: Orders for Anthropic's IPO are running at several times the shares on offer, with pricing expected above the filed range, while TSMC approved investments in both Anthropic and OpenAI.

item.title: Manchester United Sack Michael Carrick After Worst Start in Decades
item.description: Michael Carrick was fired on Thursday after overseeing the club's worst start to a Premier League season, with the team 18th in the table and one league win to its name.

item.title: IPL 2027's Biggest Trade: Hardik Pandya to Punjab, Arshdeep Singh to Mumbai
item.description: Mumbai Indians traded former captain Hardik Pandya to Punjab Kings for Rs 18 crore in a swap with Arshdeep Singh, the biggest player trade in IPL history, ahead of the November 17 retention deadline.

item.title: India Eye Series Win in 4th ODI as Pant Gets Fitness Clearance for Tests
item.description: India need one more win to seal the five-match ODI series against New Zealand in Friday's fourth match at Bay Oval, while Rishabh Pant has been cleared fit and is on his way to join the Test squad.

item.title: Ramayana Crosses Rs 511 Crore in Seven Days, Enters Oscars VFX Race
item.description: The Ranbir Kapoor and Yash epic crossed Rs 511 crore net at the Indian box office in its first week despite a sharp weekday drop, and its makers have submitted it independently for the Oscars 2027 visual effects category.

item.title: Salman Khan Wishes Shraddha Kapoor's Eetha Ahead of December 4 Box Office Clash
item.description: Salman Khan extended his best wishes to the team of Eetha on social media, even as his own film Maatrubhumi is set to release on the same day, December 4, 2026.

item.title: India's Retail Inflation Rises to 6.09%, Above RBI's Tolerance Band
item.description: Retail inflation climbed to 6.09 percent in October from 5.54 percent in September, breaching the RBI's upper tolerance limit, even as stock markets gained for a third straight session and the rupee slipped to 94.04 against the dollar.

item.title: Cabinet Clears Rs 62,370 Crore Fertiliser Subsidy as Moody's Lifts India Growth Forecast to 7%
item.description: The Union Cabinet approved a fertiliser subsidy package 64 percent larger than last year's for the Rabi season, while Moody's raised India's FY27 growth forecast and flagged inflation risks.

item.title: COP31 Leaders Warn Wars Must Not Eclipse Climate Action
item.description: On the third day of the COP31 summit in Antalya, the leaders of Brazil and Turkey said wars and trade disputes must not distract the world from the fight against global warming.

item.title: YouTube Trending Today: GTA 6, Maatrubhumi Trailer and the Nvidia Story Dominate
item.description: GTA 6 pre-load news topped YouTube's worldwide charts, the Maatrubhumi trailer was the most-viewed video in the US, and reports of an Nvidia board investigation drove the day's biggest news discussion on the platform.

item.title: PM Modi to Flag Off Bengaluru-Mangaluru-Madgaon Vande Bharat Express
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the new semi-high-speed train on November 13, improving rail connectivity between Bengaluru, coastal Karnataka and Goa.
